source.check: returned unopposed: the only nomination for Keady in the paper's list of all 23 divisions, read on the BNA page image and keyed twice from two crops (no differences); the contests were Bellarena, Drumraighland (withdrawn), Drumsurn and Dungiven

note: Triennial election of the rural district councillors, polled Thursday 2 June 1955. Nominations closed on 17 May 1955; after the Drumraighland withdrawal three divisions (Bellarena, Drumsurn, Dungiven) went to the poll (Londonderry Standard, 20 May 1955, p. 5). The Londonderry Standard of 18 May 1955, p. 4 prints the nominations for all 23 divisions, completing the list that the Derry Journal and Londonderry Sentinel print only as far as Gelvin. The paper prints 'Harkinson'; the member returned for Keady in 1952 and 1958 is Thomas Harbinson. Returned unopposed.
